subject.name: Instacart
subject.audience: people shopping for groceries, from a quick reorder to a meal worth savoring
subject.primaryJob: carry someone from shopping to savoring

principles: optimism and warmth in everyday life

territories.name: The kitchen table
territories.description: Fresh produce on a cream ground: deep kale fields, one carrot accent and food photographed up close.

muse.name: a carrot
muse.take: one bright cut through calm grounds: the palette cleanser (I025)

signature.reason: I078 ties a frame's radius to the pill button so the two shapes read as family, a soft answer to the kitchen-table territory

rationale.grounding.primary: Inferred, not stated by the source. Departs from the canon's layered depth: fields here are flat.
rationale.type.faces: Stand-ins. Instacart Contrast and Sans (I037, I038) are outside the catalogue; DM Serif Display and Manrope are the closest in kind.
rationale.form.curvature: pill buttons and gently rounded frames (I078)
rationale.type.weights: DM Serif Display has one weight; the stand-in stays at it.
rationale.adaptivity: Kale and Cashew work as the black and white (I025)
rationale.territories.character: Departs from the market's tight space and soft corners: I078 and I031 are open and rounder.
rationale.color.anchors.0: I025, printed HEX. I029 misprints Kale as #BA0239, Pomegranate's value.
rationale.color.anchors.8: Kale and Cashew are the brand's black and white (I025).
